title: Season Progression — Skill Trend
dataSources: E-bike rides (`ebike:ride`), scooter trips (`scooter:trip`), skate sessions (`skate:session`), surf sessions (`surf:session`), snow runs (`snow:run`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sport trackers — e-bike / e-scooter apps (VanMoof, Bosch eBike Flow), and skate / surf / snow session trackers (Trace, Slopes, Xensr) with IMU sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=surf:session OR sourcetype=snow:run OR sourcetype=skate:session)
| timechart span=1mon avg(skill_score) as skill by sport
description: Trends a per-session skill score across a season so you can see steady improvement in your chosen sport.
value: A season-long skill curve rewards consistency and shows whether coaching or practice is actually paying off.
implementation: Ingest per-session skill scores into `index=personal`; trend by sport over the season.
visualization: Line chart of skill score over the season by sport.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks your skill through the season across board and snow sports, showing steady improvement.
